headline: Ajaib Crypto Launches Tokenized Stock Perpetual SpaceX, NVIDIA, Tesla
summary: Indonesian crypto platform Ajaib Kripto has launched nine tokenized stock perpetual contract pairs, including SpaceX, NVIDIA and Tesla, with 24-hour access.
why: Perpetual contracts are derivatives without an expiry date that let traders take leveraged positions on an asset's price. Tokenized stock products bring exposure to listed equities into crypto trading venues.
original_headline: Ajaib Kripto Hadirkan Tokenized Stock Perpetual SpaceX, NVIDIA, Tesla
